steps.title: Place plate on magnetic module
steps.instruction: Move the 96‑well deepwell working plate containing the bead‑antibody‑target complex to the magnetic module located in slot 1 of the OT‑2.

steps.title: Remove supernatant with magnetic module
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module, then use the 8‑channel pipette to aspirate and discard all supernatant from the working plate (located in slot 4).

steps.title: Add wash buffer and resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Transfer wash buffer from the reservoir in slot 2 to the working plate in slot 1 using the 8‑channel pipette, turn the magnetic module off, resuspend the beads by mixing, re‑engage the magnetic module, and remove the wash supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Transfer wash buffer from slot 2 to slot 1.

steps.title: Repeat wash two additional times
steps.instruction: Perform the wash‑resuspend‑remove sequence described in the previous step two more times, reusing the same 8‑channel pipette tips.

steps.title: Add elution buffer from tube
steps.instruction: Using a single‑channel pipette, transfer elution buffer from the 15 mL tube in slot 4 to the working plate in slot 1.

steps.title: Mix and transfer eluate to final plate
steps.instruction: Mix the beads with the added elution buffer, then use the 8‑channel pipette to transfer the eluate to the final plate located in slot 3.

steps.title: Seal plate and heat at 70 °C
steps.instruction: Seal the final plate, activate the temperature module, and heat the plate at 70 °C for 10 minutes.
